location_description:
Aiea (; Hawaiian: ʻAiea, pronounced [ʔɐjˈɛjə]) is a census-designated place (CDP) located in the City and County of Honolulu, Hawaii, United States. As of the 2010 Census, the CDP had a total population of 9,338.


== Geography ==
Aiea is located at 21°23′9″N 157°55′51″W (21.385900, −157.930927).
